It's the end of season four and Invincible, Nolan, Allen and a bunch of other idiots are facing against the Viltrumite empire. However Thragg and Conquest are all but appetizers for their true greatest threat; flying PNGs voiced by A-list celebrities. They might move around like they're being dragged and dropped, but at least they have 3 Breaking Bad voice actors. Maybe.
